sources.note: Read-only, polite: robots.txt of www.banxico.org.mx answers 302 to anterior.banxico.org.mx/robots.txt (rules: /dyn, /ALEPH, /V for every agent), followed per RFC 9309. The token goes only to www.banxico.org.mx in the Bmx-Token header. 5 requests per run (metadata + one per series), far below the documented limits. Status active since the first real run (workflow indicadores-mx, run 39709378896, 2026-10-22): the four series reconciled (SF43718 8783/8783, SP68257 11524/11524, SF331451 5231/5231, SF43783 7943/7943; 33,481 observations) and the test fixtures are its real bytes. Seen in those bytes: compact JSON, every dato a JSON string, dates dd/mm/yyyy, 'N/E' only in SF43783 (200, 1995-1996), metadata in its own order with a 'versionada' field. The run asks up to today: values already published with a later date (UDIS to 25/10/2026, TIIE 28 to 22/10/2026 in that run's metadata) enter in a later run.

series.label: INPC, índice general (base 2a. quincena de julio 2018 = 100)
series.id_status: Confirmada 2026-10-23: la nota del INEGI en el DOF del 09/10/2026 (5800864) dice "Con base en la segunda quincena de julio de 2018=100 el Índice Nacional de Precios al Consumidor del mes de septiembre de 2026 es 146.075"; esta clave sirve 146.07499999999999000000 para 2026/09 y 145.46199999999999000000 para 2026/08 (la misma nota: 146.075 y 145.462) (corrida 39877667471). El título se copia de esas dos frases de la nota. La clave anterior, 628194, sirve los mismos valores hasta 2024/07 y ahí termina (LASTUPDATE 09/10/2024).

sources.note: Read-only, polite: robots.txt of www.inegi.org.mx allows /app. The token is a path segment of every API URL (documented syntax .../INDICATOR/[IdIndicador]/[Idioma]/[Área]/[Recientes]/[Fuente]/[Versión]/[Token]?type=[Formato]); every recorded URL carries '<token>' instead. 'false' asks for the whole historical series (documented); there is no date range. Fuente: 'BIE' and 'BISE' answer HTTP 400 for the INPC keys and 'BIE-BISE' answers 200 with área 00 and 00000 (sonda, runs 39870811830, 39870891633, 39875830218; INEGI's query builder says the BIE now lives inside the BISE). CL_INDICATOR answers HTTP 401 'No autorizado' (ErrorCode 110) to our token for every key, the documented example included, so it is not requested; each series carries its title copied from the official publication in confirmed_by. Real bytes: indicadores-mx run 39877667471 (2026-10-23), tests/fixtures/inegi_bie_indicator_910392_2026-10-23.json.
